ModMetaData.name: Storage Overview: All Filters in One Table
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Warning: this mod was written with AI coding tools (Claude Code).
Shows the storage filters of every stockpile, shelf and storage group on the map side by side in one table.
Opening it Select any stockpile or storage building and click the Overview tab next to the vanilla Storage tab. The table opens scrolled to the storage you selected.
The table - The item tree on the left is the vanilla storage tree; each storage is a column of the usual checkboxes, and opening a category opens it for every column. - Ticking a box works exactly like the vanilla storage tab, including click-and-drag painting. - Priority, hit points and quality are rows at the top. - Storages with identical settings are merged into one column (can be turned off). - Click a storage name to show it on the map; right-click it to rename it or copy and paste its settings.
Finding what to change - Show all items, only items on the map, or only items no storage accepts. - Search items and storages by name. - Mark items to move the storages that accept them to the left. - A blue outline shows the storage haulers take an item to; a light blue cell shows what a storage holds now; rows no storage accepts are dimmed.
Tested on RimWorld 1.7. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
